item.title: The First Descendant Hotfix 1.4.3d
item.description:
Greetings, Descendants.

We would like to inform you about the details for The First Descendant Hotfix 1.4.3d.

This patch will be applied without a client update, allowing immediate access without additional downloads.

For Descendants currently in-game, please return to the title screen and reconnect to apply the patch.

item.title: Counter-Strike 2 Update
item.description:
\[ RUSH ]

  • Increased the maximum countdown-after-elimination time from 7 seconds to 14 seconds on end rooms and Convoy.

  • The countdown-after-elimination time does not activate in cases where an entire team dies to suicides, team kills, and/or disconnects.

  • Warmup time once all players have connected, freeze time, and technical timeout time are all reduced.
